# langfuse_evaluator (Resource)

Manages an evaluator in a Langfuse project using the stable evaluators API (`/api/public/v2/evaluators`). An evaluator defines how Langfuse scores observations: either an LLM-as-a-judge prompt with a structured output, or deterministic source code. Changing any definition attribute creates a new evaluator version on the same stable ID; evaluation rules referencing this evaluator automatically use the latest version. Changing only `name` or `description` does not create a version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# LLM-as-a-judge evaluator with a numeric score.
# Changing prompt, model_config, variable_mapping or output_definition creates a
# new version on the same evaluator; rules automatically pick up the latest one.
resource "langfuse_evaluator" "helpfulness" {
  project_public_key = local.langfuse_project_public_key
  project_secret_key = local.langfuse_project_secret_key

  name        = "Helpfulness"
  description = "Scores how helpful the answer is for the user's question."
  type        = "llm_as_judge"

  prompt = [
    {
      role    = "system"
      content = "You are a strict but fair evaluator."
    },
    {
      role    = "user"
      content = "Question: {{input}}\n\nAnswer: {{output}}\n\nRate the helpfulness of the answer from 0 to 1."
    },
  ]

  # Omit model_config to use the project's default evaluation model.
  model_config = {
    provider = langfuse_llm_connection.openai.provider_name
    model    = "gpt-4.1-mini"
  }

  variable_mapping = [
    { variable = "input", source = "input" },
    { variable = "output", source = "output" },
  ]

  output_definition = {
    data_type                    = "NUMERIC"
    min_value                    = 0
    max_value                    = 1
    score_reasoning_instructions = "Explain the rating in one sentence."
  }
}

# Categorical LLM-as-a-judge evaluator.
resource "langfuse_evaluator" "tone" {
  project_public_key = local.langfuse_project_public_key
  project_secret_key = local.langfuse_project_secret_key

  name = "Tone"
  type = "llm_as_judge"

  prompt = [
    {
      role    = "user"
      content = "Classify the tone of the following answer: {{output}}"
    },
  ]

  output_definition = {
    data_type                     = "CATEGORICAL"
    categories                    = ["friendly", "neutral", "rude"]
    should_allow_multiple_matches = false
  }
}

# Deterministic code evaluator.
resource "langfuse_evaluator" "answer_length" {
  project_public_key = local.langfuse_project_public_key
  project_secret_key = local.langfuse_project_secret_key

  name                 = "Answer length"
  type                 = "code"
  source_code_language = "PYTHON"
  source_code          = <<-PY
    def evaluate(ctx: EvaluationContext) -> EvaluationResult:
        return EvaluationResult(
            scores=[
                Score(
                    name="answer_length_ok",
                    value=len(str(ctx.observation.output or "")) <= 500,
                    data_type="BOOLEAN",
                )
            ]
        )
  PY
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable evaluator name. Names are not identifiers and do not need to be unique.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.
- `type` (String) The evaluator type. Valid values: `llm_as_judge`, `code`. The type of an existing evaluator cannot change, so changing it recreates the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable evaluator description.
- `model_config` (Attributes) Explicit model configuration for an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. Omit to use the project's default evaluation model. The provider must match a `provider_name` of an existing `langfuse_llm_connection` in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_config))
- `output_definition` (Attributes) Structured output schema returned by an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. Required for `llm_as_judge`; must not be set for `code`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--output_definition))
- `prompt` (Attributes List) Ordered chat messages used by an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. Variables use `{{variable}}` syntax. A `system` message is only allowed as the first message. Required for `llm_as_judge`; must not be set for `code`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prompt))
- `source_code` (String) Source code executed for each matched observation by a `code` evaluator. Required for `code`; must not be set for `llm_as_judge`.
- `source_code_language` (String) Runtime language of a `code` evaluator. Valid values: `PYTHON`, `TYPESCRIPT`. Required for `code`; must not be set for `llm_as_judge`.
- `variable_mapping` (Attributes List) Default prompt-variable mapping for an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. Each variable extracted from the prompt must be mapped exactly once. Evaluation rules may override this per assignment. Must not be set for `code`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variable_mapping))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable identifier of the evaluator, shared across all of its versions.
- `status` (String) Effective runtime status after Langfuse validates the configuration: `active` or `paused`.
- `variables` (List of String) Variables extracted from the prompt of an `llm_as_judge` evaluator. Use these to build `variable_mapping` entries.
- `version` (Number) The latest evaluator version number. Increases each time a definition attribute changes.
- `version_id` (String) The stable identifier of the latest evaluator version.

<a id="nestedatt--model_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_config`

Required:

- `model` (String) Model identifier exposed by the provider, for example `gpt-4.1-mini`.
- `provider` (String) Provider identifier, for example `openai` or `anthropic`, matching an LLM connection in the project.


<a id="nestedatt--output_definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `output_definition`

Required:

- `data_type` (String) Score type. Valid values: `NUMERIC`, `BOOLEAN`, `CATEGORICAL`.

Optional:

- `categories` (List of String) Allowed category values. Required for `CATEGORICAL` (at least two unique values); must not be set otherwise.
- `max_value` (Number) Optional inclusive maximum value. Only valid for `NUMERIC`. Must not be lower than `min_value`.
- `min_value` (Number) Optional inclusive minimum value. Only valid for `NUMERIC`.
- `score_reasoning_instructions` (String) Optional instructions for deriving the reasoning returned with the score.
- `score_value_instructions` (String) Optional instructions for deriving the score value.
- `should_allow_multiple_matches` (Boolean) Whether a `CATEGORICAL` evaluator may return more than one category. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--prompt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prompt`

Required:

- `content` (String) Message content. Evaluator variables use `{{variable}}` syntax.
- `role` (String) Role of the message. Valid values: `system`, `user`, `assistant`.


<a id="nestedatt--variable_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variable_mapping`

Required:

- `source` (String) Observation field that populates the variable. Valid values: `input`, `output`, `metadata`, `tool_calls`, `expected_output`, `experiment_item_metadata`.
- `variable` (String) Prompt variable name without braces. For the prompt `Judge {{input}}` use `input`.

Optional:

- `json_path` (String) Optional JSONPath selector, for example `$.answer`, applied to the source before it is inserted into the prompt. Validated by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID format: <project_public_key>:<project_secret_key>:<evaluator_id>
terraform import langfuse_evaluator.helpfulness "pk-lf-...:sk-lf-...:cm1evaluator000000000000000"
```
